question: If "A" is coded as 2, "B" as 4, "a" as 11, "b" as 12 (following a pattern for capitals and small letters), what is the code for "Hi"?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For capital letter → Place value × 2 

For small letter → 1 is positioned ahead of place value → '1' ' Place value'

"A" is coded as 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2bf3c547f3a19e475615ea3ad172846257f1c22560b0ba9674998fb0adde719.png] 

"B" as 4

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7cc7fc45b6051d6550beb0bea8cadd4ffc41f5d89f46dd0c21f7785e01b156e.png] 

"a" as 11

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/434abd710f243448620a1fb2271b529e3f6cf8953ba752fdc8599376b37bab73.png] 

"b" as 12

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ab749eaced18455c4fd929c3e9b07841a8c10f6599183c067fdef5e6c908bb7.png] 

Similarly,

"Hi" is coded as

For 'H'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f25bdd5ddc5adf2897d17cffeeb8610549f11dcc77bfe3df2594b151f69782c.png] 

For 'i'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bd178c1b7f86125d94b3bb62841ae847f199a0f7c9bc20e7a2b233768217984.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
